content:
The image shows a coffee leaf with multiple circular lesions that have distinct light gray/tan centers surrounded by reddish-brown rings and yellow halos. This "eye-like" appearance with concentric zones is the hallmark of Brown Eye Spot (Cercospora coffeicola). Coffee rust would instead show orange/yellow powdery pustules without the defined eye-shaped centers.
